statuses.confirmed: a second figure agrees within the check's own tolerance
statuses.differs_stated: they differ, and the input states a reason for that unit
statuses.differs_unexplained: they differ, and nothing says why
statuses.unchecked: the unit exists but has no second figure to compare

coverage_classes.independent: a figure from outside the source is compared and a verdict stored
coverage_classes.internal: compared only against the source's own other output — coherence, not correctness
coverage_classes.single_source: no second source exists among this repo's inputs
coverage_classes.unchecked: a second source exists in principle; no structured verdict is stored

failure_classes.wrong_file: another company's export, or another pull of it
failure_classes.wrong_cell: the right file, the wrong row or column
failure_classes.wrong_unit: the right cell, the wrong scale or currency
failure_classes.wrong_period: the right figure for another period, or another vintage of it
failure_classes.different_definition: the same name on a figure built another way

checks.title: A release's reported revenue vs the same fiscal period in XBRL
checks.subject: 8-K EX-99.1 revenue actual (primary_source.releases[].reconciliation, metric revenue)
checks.second_source: EDGAR XBRL from the filer's 10-Q/10-K (`companyfacts`, the SEC cache) for the fiscal period the row's label names in the filer's own calendar: the first revenue alias reporting it (CONCEPT_ALIASES['revenue']) — the discrete fact, else year-to-date less the prior year-to-date (a fourth quarter is its year less nine months); the filing on or after the release governs
checks.tolerance: differs beyond 0.5% of the XBRL figure AND by at least $1M (statement_recon.DIFFERENT_SHARE / DIFFERENT_FLOOR), the share widened to half a unit of the release's own stated figure ('$1.5 billion' ±$50M)
checks.population: every revenue actual on a committed page whose filer's facts are cached; a label the filer's calendar cannot place, or a period no 10-Q/10-K has reported yet, is unchecked
checks.stated_reason: another revenue alias or another filing carries the release's figure for the period (a recast)

checks.title: A revenue guide's level vs the filer's revenue for the same scope a year earlier
checks.subject: 8-K EX-99.1 revenue level guide ($M), its midpoint, at the scope its label states (period_scope: a quarter, or annual — `next-fy` reads annual)
checks.second_source: EDGAR XBRL revenue for the latest period of that scope (the same quarter, or the fiscal year) ending before the release was filed, as filed by then
checks.tolerance: the midpoint within 2x either way (release.SCALE_BAND): a quarterly guide filed as a year reads ~0.25 and billions read as millions ~0.001
checks.population: every revenue level guide on a committed page; a name more than doubling or halving its revenue differs here for a true reason

checks.title: Each stored figure is stated in its own quote, at its scale
checks.subject: every structured figure stored beside a quote: release actuals (value), guide bounds (low, high), one-offs (amount), event impacts (low, high), and covenant rate components (margin_pct, margin_bps, floor_pct, pik_pct)
checks.second_source: the figure's own stored quote (`verbatim`; a covenant row's note), read through release_parse.quoted_figures
checks.tolerance: exact at the quote's stated scale: the value is one figure the quote states — $M where the quote states a scale word, a bare dollar figure per share, %, basis points (a range's unit-less low side takes the high side's unit; 'zero' is 0). A quote PROVES presence (vinci.verbatim); this asks whether it SUPPORTS the value
checks.stated_reason: the release quote is cut at its 200-character cap (release_parse._verbatim) before the figure

the gross margin a release reports

coverage.note: internal on the quote alone: a non-GAAP figure is the filer's own and no XBRL tag carries it; CIQ's EBITDA is CIQ's normalisation, not the filer's. GAAP DILUTED EPS is not read as an actual by the parser (no row on any page), so the XBRL EPS figure has nothing to be set against

coverage.carries: guidance ranges: level and change, every metric
unscored: ciq.guide_vs_release — CIQ's revenue guide against the release's, scored in the ciq source
coverage.note: the level check runs on revenue guides only; a guide of another metric has its period and its quote checked, not its size

coverage.carries: a credit agreement's rate components (margin, floor, PIK)
coverage.note: internal on the quote alone; the quote's presence in the exhibit is checked at assembly (vinci.verbatim). CIQ's capital-structure panel carries coupons and is not set against these
